drop
Syntax
drop
drop
Causes the current packet or connection (depending on the context of
the event) to be discarded. Nothing is sent to the client.
Marks the corresponding entry from the system connection table for
immediate timeout. The flow will be deleted when the reaping process
next runs. Until then packets will be accepted to the flow. This is
noticable at high packet rates.
Note that, in the case of TCP, if subsequent segments arrive without
SYN bit set (and ACK bit unset), a RST will be sent as a result. This
is the standard behavior when segments of that type arrive when there
is no system connection entry.
